description: This file defines the ContentTypeHandler class which manages different ContentType objects, handles content extension retrieval, and determines the appropriate content type for a given node.

classes.name: ContentTypeHandler
classes.description: Handles multiple ContentType instances, retrieves content extensions, and identifies the correct ContentType for a node.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an array of ContentType objects, reversing the array order.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Returns an array of all unique content file extensions supported by the registered ContentTypes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines and returns the ContentType capable of handling the provided Content node based on its extension. Throws an exception if none match.
